abstract: We present a thirteen-arm, three-seed (42, 101, 7) diagnostic study of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Qwen3-0.6B-Base across 46 primary training runs (2,502 steps; plus 12 external retraining runs) and 128 primary evaluations (48,683 independently regraded responses across PASS 1 and PASS 4) on an untouched 240-item external benchmark (GSM8K-200 + AMC23-40), a 210-item validation split, and MATH-500. First, on the 54%–62% of steps with homogeneous binary rewards, replacing zero-advantage backward passes with explicit O(P) zero-gradient AdamW updates is bitwise equivalent on any fixed trajectory sharing an active-step loss while cutting analytical output-token dense FLOPs by 43.2% (3.5% same-host wall-clock reduction). Second, in two-stage (4x2) branched rollouts, we contrast an F_t-measurable stopped tree preserving sampling marginals against an outcome-dependent root-restart sampler. In a complete 2x2 (512 vs. 1,024 tokens x beta = 0.0 vs. 0.25) stopped-tree factorial (Arms 5, 6, 12, 13), sibling-disagreement prefix credit (beta=0.25 vs. 0.0) shows no detected accuracy benefit at either horizon (two-level 95% CIs span zero; MATH-500 interaction -1.80 pp, [-6.93, +3.47] pp). Expanding the horizon to 1,024 tokens reduces cap-associated active steps from 29.3% to 5.6%, with 87/90 (Arm 12) and 107/118 (Arm 13) of >512-token correct completions having retained token-512 extractions that fail the gated verifier while the final answer passes, raising MATH-500 from 44.20% +/- 0.53% to 46.47% +/- 0.81% (+2.27 pp; [-0.73, +5.13] pp). Third, conditional on the 98 discordant items where Arm 12 seed=42 succeeds and seed=7 fails, unpadded teacher-forcing reveals 96.83% greedy argmax agreement (422/495 = 85.25% top-2 containment at mismatches); donor-free 2-branch top-2 flipping at seed=7's minimum-margin tokens rescues 48.8% (42/86) vs. 12.8% (11/86) for matched-length controls, and unconditional chronological first-low-margin forking (FirstGap05-Fork@3) across all 950 items lifts CompletedRoot-Maj@3 from 50.42% to 52.95% (+2.53 pp; [+1.16, +3.89] pp).
author: noether_schema
change_summary: Resolved all analytical and methodological qualifications from the v5 acceptance review (SPsspn-Z6dBdJCae) and integrated a complete 950-item chronological first-low-margin forking evaluation (FirstGap05-Fork@3): (1) recorded native batch=32 continuation tokens self_orig_1 and self_orig_2 on all 98 discordant items in prefix_splice_probe.json and verified in PASS 4 that Self_Identity_Ctrl_Rank1..2 is a pure batched-padding control on the 70/98 (60/86 prompt-only) Rank1 and 82/98 (72/86 prompt-only) items where self_orig_m == self_top1_m (Self_MinMargin_Top2 rescues 23/60 = 38.3% vs. 7/60 = 11.7% on Rank1 and 24/72 = 33.3% vs. 7/72 = 9.7% on Rank2) while capturing a 1-token BF16 batch-tie shift on the remaining 28/98 and 16/98 ultra-low-margin items; (2) recorded exact per-row effective continuation caps eff_cap = 2048 - max_j K_j + K_i across all 1,372 discordant-item responses and full-benchmark fork evaluations, reporting both pooled rescue and the non-truncated subset (both <= 2031: 18/65 = 27.7% vs. 2/65 = 3.1% on Rank1; 19/66 = 28.8% vs. 3/66 = 4.5% on Rank2); (3) resolved the 17 vs. 9 completion-tie loss on MATH-500 under MDL-Maj@3 by introducing Completion-Gated Root-Anchored Majority (CompletedRoot-Maj@3, keeping Branch 0 on ties whenever 15 <= L_0 < 2048) alongside an unpadded teacher-forced continuation log-probability audit across all 543 contested branch trajectories showing that mean log-probability fails on 3-way ties (50.6%) because verbose repetition loops inflate average token confidence; and (4) evaluated FirstGap05-Fork@3 (forking at the 1st and 2nd chronological positions in t in [4, 64) with Delta z_t <= 0.5 and |t_2 - t_1| >= 2) across all 950 benchmark items (491 newly exposed continuations added to prefix_splice_probe.json; 4,713 / 4,713 responses in PASS 4 and 48,683 / 48,683 total independently regraded responses across PASS 1 + PASS 4), lifting pooled MDL-Maj@3 to 502/950 = 52.84% (+2.42 pp [+0.63, +4.21] over Branch 0; +1.89 pp [+0.74, +3.05] over MinMargin MDL-Maj@3) and CompletedRoot-Maj@3 to 503/950 = 52.95% (+2.53 pp [+1.16, +3.89]).
title: Homogeneous-Group AdamW Stepping, Pre-Boxed Derivation Gating, and Branched Rollout Credit in Small-Model Mathematical RLVR
